report_name: Intel and AMD release patches for over 80 vulnerabilities in August 2026

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-6726
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity vulnerability in the AMD Vitis development environment that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and private key disclosure.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-6727
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity vulnerability in the AMD Vitis development environment that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and private key disclosure.

vulnerabilities.name: Intel August 2026 Vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.description: A collection of 72 CVEs patched by Intel in August 2026, affecting products like PROSet/Wireless WiFi, Xeon processors, and AI tools, leading to high-severity privilege escalation and DoS flaws.
affected_products: Intel Converged Security and Management Engine (CSME)

vulnerabilities.name: AMD August 2026 Vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.description: A collection of approximately 10 vulnerabilities patched by AMD in August 2026, affecting products like Ryzen Master Utility and SEV technology, which could lead to arbitrary code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: PowerHooK
vulnerabilities.description: A side-channel attack against AMD's Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) technology for which mitigation guidance was provided.

indicators.name: RyzenMaster.exe Execution
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: AMD Ryzen Master Utility Execution
id: 2b1a9c8d-f3e4-4d5c-8a7b-1e2f3d4c5b6a
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of the AMD Ryzen Master Utility, which could be exploited due to vulnerabilities mentioned in the August 2026 security updates.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/chipmaker-patch-tuesday-intel-amd-fix-over-80-vulnerabilities-combined/amp/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-14
tags:
  - attack.t1204
level: informational
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\RyzenMaster.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the AMD Ryzen Master Utility. While often legitimate, its execution could be a precursor to exploitation of associated vulnerabilities.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process of RyzenMaster.exe
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process of RyzenMaster.exe
id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-8c2b-1a9f8e7d6c5b
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious child processes spawned by the AMD Ryzen Master Utility, which could indicate exploitation of a vulnerability for arbitrary code execution or privilege escalation.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/chipmaker-patch-tuesday-intel-amd-fix-over-80-vulnerabilities-combined/amp/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-14
tags:
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.privilege_escalation
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\RyzenMaster.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate update or diagnostic processes initiated by the utility.
indicators.description: Detects suspicious child processes (e.g., command shells) spawned by the AMD Ryzen Master Utility, which could indicate exploitation for arbitrary code execution.

indicators.name: System Crash Indicating Potential Denial of Service
indicators.pattern:
title: System Crash Indicating Potential Denial of Service
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects a system crash (bugcheck), which could indicate a denial-of-service attempt against vulnerable firmware or drivers as mentioned in the August 2026 Intel/AMD advisories.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/chipmaker-patch-tuesday-intel-amd-fix-over-80-vulnerabilities-combined/amp/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-14
tags:
  - attack.t1499
  - attack.impact
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: system
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 1001
    Provider_Name: 'Microsoft-Windows-WER-SystemErrorReporting'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - System crashes due to hardware failure, driver conflicts, or other software bugs.
indicators.description: Detects unexplained system crashes or reboots by monitoring for Windows Error Reporting events related to bugchecks, which could indicate DoS attempts against vulnerable firmware or drivers.
